[[File:Clue scroll (master) detail.png|left|150px]]
A '''clue scroll (master)''' is the highest tier of [[clue scroll]]. It rewards a [[reward casket (master)|master reward casket]] upon completion. After completing 100 master clues, the player will be awarded the [[scroll sack]].

Master clue scrolls can be ''between 6 and 8 steps'' long.

Players can obtain a master clue scroll from the following methods:
*By bringing one each of the [[Clue scroll (easy)|easy]], [[Clue scroll (medium)|medium]], [[Clue scroll (hard)|hard]], and [[Clue scroll (elite)|elite]] clue scrolls to [[Watson]], who is located in the large, fenced-in house west of the [[Forthos Ruin]] in [[Hosidius]]. Clue scrolls may be handed in individually. It should be noted that if you already have the maximum number of master clue scrolls (see [[scroll case]]) for your account, Watson will still take all lower tier scrolls but NOT give you a new master scroll until you either complete or discard one of your existing master scrolls. You will not be allowed to give Watson any more lower tier scrolls until the master scroll has been claimed.
*As a potential reward from completing any easy, medium, hard or elite treasure trails, with the chances of obtaining them being 1/50, 1/30, 1/15, and 1/5 respectively.

Like elite and hard clue scrolls, master clue scrolls also have combat encounters. They include a [[Brassican Mage]], [[Double agent]] or three [[Ancient Wizard]]s (in multi-combat areas). As their tier suggests, master clues require numerous high-levelled items, requirements, and [[quests]] in order to complete them.

==Mechanics==
===Dying with a scroll===
As clue scrolls are untradeable, they are sent to the [[gravestone]] if unprotected on [[PvP]] or [[PvM]] death, even above level 20 [[Wilderness]]. [[Clue box]]es are not necessary and only add additional risk when in the Wilderness.

===Multiple clues===
As with all tiers of clue scrolls, only one master clue scroll can be held, kept in Death's Office, or stored in a bank at one time; attempting to open a [[scroll box (master)]] while holding a master clue scroll gives the message {{mes|The clue box refuses to open - you already have a clue.}} However, it is possible to drop clues on the floor, where they'll stay for one hour, allowing players to have multiple clues at once. Dropping prior clue scrolls while having done some of their steps does NOT retain the steps of the dropped clue when starting a new one.

===Casting an alchemy spell===
When casting an alchemy spell on a clue scroll, if the game setting that triggers a warning on untradeable items is disabled, a different confirmation warning is triggered, asking "wouldn't you rather solve the clue?". If the game setting is enabled, only the regular question is triggered.

|update = Run Energy Changes
|change = A restriction has been removed which prevented players from receiving a master clue for 30 seconds after they last received one.

{{Subject changes 
|date = 6 March 2024
|update = Miscellaneous Quality of Life Changes
|change = Clue Scrolls dropped by a player now last one hour on the ground rather than two minutes. This does not change existing behaviour for Clue Scrolls dropped by NPCs or other entities. Additionally, you are now told if you would have gotten a clue but didn't because you already have one.
}}

}}
